Flatbed Scanners

Our flatbed scanners are available for rental for your film and print scanning needs.

*Penumbra facilities are available to be rented by MEMBERS ONLY.

Not a member? Become one today!

WHAT’S INCLUDED?

  • 1 Epson V850 scanner

    • Compatible film holders for V850 (35mm, 120, 4x5)

  • 1 Epson V13000XL scanner for positives and transparencies (max scan size 12.2" x 17.2")

  • 1 Mac Mini equipped with EpsonScan software

RESERVE YOUR SPOT!

Rentals are available in 2-hour blocks (see below). For longer rentals, choose a 2-hour slot and use "select and add another time." For hourly rentals, email info@penumbrafoundation.org.
If you have any questions about renting our facilities, please reach out to info@penumbrafoundation.org
